name: HerMES J002737.3-020759 field (Hubble)
blurb: A deep field toward the dusty starburst galaxy HerMES J002737.3-020759, seen by Hubble.
label: hermesj002737-hubble
story: Hubble looked here for the starlight of an ultrared, dusty star-forming galaxy found in a Herschel survey. The aim was to measure its size and stellar mass, test whether gravitational lensing magnifies it, and look for neighbors in a young cluster.

claims.text: RARE-HELMS-65 is an ultraluminous infrared galaxy target at provisional position 00 27 37.37 -02 07 58.48
HerMES J002737.3-020759 (HELMS_RED_31) is an ultrared dusty star-forming galaxy selected from HerMES
Program 14083 studies the most luminous starburst galaxies, selected from the Herschel HerMES survey, to measure sizes, stellar masses, lensing amplification and protocluster membership
HELMS_RED_31 is a red Herschel source studied with ALMA
